// @path: src/lib/ops/counts.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// The permitted shape, in a second helper module rather than the declared read
// chokepoint. One place counts children, and it is the file everybody reviews.
export async function pupilsOnRoll(db, schoolId) {
  return db.student.count({ where: { class: { teacher: { schoolId } } } });
}
